subtopics.label: PET Scanner Design and Detector Technology
subtopics.description: Research on positron emission tomography hardware innovations including depth-encoding detector modules, prismatoid light-guide arrays (Prism-PET), sparse ring configurations, time-of-flight improvements, and signal processing methods for high-resolution quantitative neuroimaging and oncological imaging.

subtopics.label: Quantitative Ultrasound Imaging and Tissue Characterization
subtopics.description: Development and validation of quantitative ultrasound (QUS) methods for tissue characterization, including acoustic microscopy, backscatter coefficient analysis, ultrasound localization microscopy, and high-frequency ultrasound for assessing ocular biomechanics, lung disease, lymph node metastasis, and vascular flow.

subtopics.label: Wearable Devices and AI for Health Monitoring
subtopics.description: Research on wearable sensors and artificial intelligence algorithms for continuous monitoring, prediction, and management of health conditions including diabetes, depression, anxiety, sleep disorders, Parkinson's disease, and general physiological parameters in clinical and community settings.

subtopics.label: Tissue Engineering Scaffolds and Biomaterials
subtopics.description: Engineering of biomaterial scaffolds and constructs for tissue regeneration including 3D-printed bioabsorbable polymers, decellularized xenografts, peptide nanofiber hydrogels, collagen scaffolds, and cartilage engineering for applications in nipple reconstruction, auricular cartilage, wound healing, and organ repair.

subtopics.label: Breast Implant Design and Reconstructive Biomaterials
subtopics.description: Research on breast implant materials, surface coatings, mesh scaffolds (poly-4-hydroxybutyrate, acellular dermal matrix), and implant stability designs aimed at reducing complications such as capsular contracture, infection, and positional instability in alloplastic breast reconstruction.

subtopics.label: Nanoparticle-Based Drug Delivery and Therapeutics
subtopics.description: Engineering of nanoparticles, nanofibers, and nanoconjugates for targeted drug delivery in cancer, wound healing, and infectious disease, including ultrasmall silica nanoparticles, peptide nanofiber platforms, alpha-gal nanoparticles, alginate microparticles, and convection-enhanced delivery systems for brain tumors.

subtopics.label: Focused Ultrasound and Neuromodulation Devices
subtopics.description: Research on focused ultrasound for blood-brain barrier opening, drug delivery enhancement, and neuromodulation, as well as transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) targeting and deep brain stimulation (DBS) for neurological conditions including Alzheimer's disease, epilepsy, and traumatic brain injury.

subtopics.label: Cardiac Implantable Electronic Devices and Leadless Pacing
subtopics.description: Development and clinical evaluation of cardiac implantable electronic devices including leadless pacemakers, dual-chamber pacing systems, subcutaneous ICDs, cardiac resynchronization therapy, and left bundle branch area pacing, with focus on device performance, complications, and atrioventricular synchrony.

subtopics.label: Robotic and Minimally Invasive Surgical Systems
subtopics.description: Research on robotic surgical platforms and minimally invasive techniques across specialties including cardiac, bariatric, urologic, and general surgery, evaluating operative outcomes, learning curves, cost-effectiveness, and technical innovations in robotic-assisted procedures.

subtopics.label: Image-Guided and Augmented Reality Navigation in Spine Surgery
subtopics.description: Engineering and clinical evaluation of navigation technologies for spinal surgery including 3D intraoperative navigation, augmented reality overlays, robotic assistance, and image fusion for pedicle screw placement, minimally invasive transforaminal lumbar interbody fusion, and endoscopic spine procedures.

subtopics.label: Soft Robotic Catheters and Flexible Electronics for Cardiac Mapping
subtopics.description: Design and validation of catheter-deployable soft robotic devices integrated with flexible and stretchable electronics for high-density cardiac electrophysiology mapping, including conformable sensor arrays for left atrial arrhythmia mapping and ablation guidance.

subtopics.label: 3D Printing for Medical Devices and Surgical Simulation
subtopics.description: Application of 3D printing technology to create low-cost surgical simulators, anatomical training models, patient-specific surgical guides, and functional medical devices including laryngeal models, thyroplasty simulators, laparoscopic cannulas, and coronary artery models for procedural training and planning.

subtopics.label: Advanced MRI Reconstruction and Quantitative Imaging
subtopics.description: Development of computational methods for MRI image reconstruction and quantitative mapping including quantitative susceptibility mapping, fMRI motion correction, deep learning-based reconstruction, and multiecho field inversion techniques for improved neuroimaging and body imaging accuracy.

subtopics.label: Ocular Biomechanics, Imaging Devices, and Ophthalmic Technology
subtopics.description: Research on biomechanical characterization of ocular tissues in myopia and glaucoma, development of ophthalmic imaging and measurement devices, and analysis of adverse events associated with ophthalmic surgical devices including vitrectomy platforms and intraocular lens fixation systems.

subtopics.label: Vascularization Strategies for Tissue Engineering and Organoids
subtopics.description: Engineering approaches to achieve functional vascularization in tissue-engineered constructs and organoids, including adaptable endothelial cell platforms, prevascularized scaffolds, and islet transplantation with engineered vasculature for subcutaneous engraftment and organ-on-chip applications.

subtopics.label: Spinal Implants, Fusion Devices, and Disc Degeneration
subtopics.description: Research on spinal implants including cervical cages, interbody fusion devices, disc arthroplasty prostheses, and the biomechanics and pathomechanisms of intervertebral disc degeneration. Covers clinical outcomes, implant materials, and fusion rates.

subtopics.label: Minimally Invasive and Endoscopic Spine Surgery
subtopics.description: Research on minimally invasive spine surgery techniques including endoscopic approaches, transforaminal discectomy, foraminotomy, and associated complications, training, and intraoperative monitoring methods.

subtopics.label: Telemedicine, Augmented Reality, and Remote Surgical Support
subtopics.description: Studies on augmented reality, smart glasses, and telemedical platforms used to support surgical procedures and clinical training remotely, including applications in low- and middle-income country settings.

subtopics.label: Orofacial and Respiratory Strength Assessment Devices
subtopics.description: Research on devices and tools for measuring tongue, lip, cheek, and respiratory muscle strength, including validation of low-cost manometers and handheld cough testing instruments for dysphagia and pulmonary assessment.

subtopics.label: Seizure Detection Devices and Neurological Monitoring
subtopics.description: Research on commercial and research-grade devices for detecting seizures using acoustic, wearable, or electrophysiological signals, as well as EEG-based monitoring of brain-injured patients.

subtopics.label: Osseointegrated Prostheses for Limb Amputees
subtopics.description: Studies on osseointegrated implant systems for lower limb amputees, covering cost-benefit analyses, infection management, surgical complications, and concurrent soft tissue procedures to optimize outcomes.

subtopics.label: Deep Learning and AI for Medical Image Analysis
subtopics.description: Research applying deep learning and AI methods to medical image segmentation, classification, and multimodal analysis across biomedical imaging modalities including OCT, laryngoscopy, thermography, and vascular imaging.

subtopics.label: Cardiac Regeneration and Cardiomyocyte Research
subtopics.description: Research on cardiac tissue regeneration strategies, isolation and characterization of cardiomyocytes from human and animal myocardium, and electrophysiological phenotyping of iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes for drug testing.

subtopics.label: Assistive Technology and mHealth for Older Adults and Cognitive Impairment
subtopics.description: Studies on the design, usability, and effectiveness of assistive technologies, smartwatches, mHealth apps, and remote sensing systems for older adults with cognitive impairments or dexterity limitations.

subtopics.label: Point-of-Care Diagnostics and Rapid Testing Systems
subtopics.description: Research on portable, rapid, and low-cost diagnostic platforms for infectious diseases and metabolic conditions, including isothermal nucleic acid testing for COVID-19 and closed-loop insulin delivery systems.

subtopics.label: Surgical Ergonomics, Training, and Simulation
subtopics.description: Research on ergonomic challenges in surgical practice (particularly for female surgeons), operative learning curves, and simulation-based training tools including manikins and virtual reality for procedural skill development.

subtopics.label: Optogenetics for Retinal and Neural Applications
subtopics.description: Research on engineering platforms and cellular mechanisms for optogenetic therapy targeting retinal degenerative diseases and non-neuronal cell habituation, including clinical translation of light-activated interventions.

subtopics.label: Acoustic and Ultrasound-Based Biomedical Tools
subtopics.description: Research on novel acoustic and ultrasound-based devices for biomedical applications including arteriovenous fistula stenosis detection via blood flow sounds, acousto-hydrodynamic oocyte manipulation, and low-intensity pulsed ultrasound for fracture healing.

subtopics.label: Breast Reconstruction Surgical Techniques and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on surgical techniques and outcomes in breast reconstruction including fat grafting, cryoablation for early-stage breast cancer, nerve repair methods, and nipple reconstruction using autologous cartilage scaffolds.

subtopics.label: Brain Vascular Imaging and Hemodynamics
subtopics.description: Research on imaging and measurement of cerebrovascular hemodynamics including third harmonic generation microscopy for cortical vessel flow, MRI-based oxygen extraction fraction mapping, and cerebral venous perfusion pressure modeling.
